top_signals.title: US Will Not Tackle Debt Until Republicans, Democrats Come Together, Says Rep. Arrington
top_signals.summary: House Budget Chairman Jodey Arrington said 'Republicans and Democrats are going to have to come together' on a debt reduction plan to counteract the demographic challenges of increasing Social Security and Medicare beneficiaries. Arrington also discussed the pushback against AI data centers around the country, saying that the US has win the AI race but there should be guardrails on drawing on energy and water resources to do so.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Anthropic’s Mega-IPO Plan Looms Over IPO Market
top_signals.summary: Anthropic's IPO is casting a long shadow over companies’ US listing plans, as they try to find room for their deals to grab attention after the Sept. 7 Labor Day holiday. Scarlet Fu reports on Bloomberg Deals. (Source: Bloomberg)
